name: How long does a typical residential remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical residential remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a residential remodeling project varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A bathroom remodel might take a few weeks, while a whole-home renovation or significant addition could span several months. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and unforeseen structural discoveries can all affect the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule at the outset to give you a clear understanding of the anticipated phases and milestones.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope and complexity; it can range from weeks for a bathroom to months for a whole-home renovation.
